scope: Python repository ingestion, chunking, retrieval factory, lexical/neural search, code augmentation, source packing, SDK tools/runtime, benchmark wiring and offline regression tests. Historical experiment scripts are archival, not separate active engines.

findings.problem: Declared plans copied one retriever to every condition; code_aware alone differed. A vector/hybrid/agentic label could therefore run BM25.
findings.change: Use the existing policy_for condition mapping; identical knobs and correctly selected retriever/code_aware for each condition. Remove the redundant shared-initial preparation.
findings.effect_on_old_90: Both old conditions intentionally used BM25, so this wiring bug did not cause their negative difference. Their missing conditions remain a scope error.

findings.problem: The term fixed RAG obscured which retrieval method was measured.
findings.change: Document it as single-retrieval execution, with BM25/code/hybrid as separate named conditions.

findings.problem: Previous public evaluation omitted ordinary BM25 and SDK Agentic RAG.
findings.change: Freeze 20 other public questions for all five conditions before any generation.

findings.problem: Ordinary English words were promoted as exact symbols; priority/61 then displaced BM25/dense candidates, making ten of twenty code and hybrid contexts identical. Weak class/name matches also displaced relevant implementation.
findings.change: Filter long prose to code-marked names; retain short symbol queries. Do not add weak names as a new retrieval channel unless a path or direct identifier is explicit.
findings.validation: 20 raw candidate lists unchanged, 40 closed-book/BM25 control messages identical, 17 hybrid contexts changed; explicit navigation/constructor defaults regression tests retained.

storage.source_chunks: Versioned JSON and in-memory BM25 postings
storage.vector_search: FAISS IndexFlatIP, persisted NumPy matrix and provenance metadata; cosine similarity for unit vectors
storage.fusion: BM25 + dense RRF k=60, Qwen yes/no reranker
storage.sqlite: Run/events/request ledger, not a vector database

closed_book_wire_audit.knowledge_policy: Pretraining knowledge allowed; RAG source-grounded constraints are a product policy difference, not a pure source-only ablation.

known_limits: Large repositories may hit lexical file/byte admission caps. Omissions must be counted and are not evidence of source absence.
Gold source spans are not provided by SWE-QA; no automatic gold Recall@K claim.
Current grading is Codex model-assisted and nonblind, not the paper judge or human approval.
